**[Paragraph 3 --- Initiation; Confirmation; Termination]{.underline}**

**(a) Initiation.** A Transaction may be entered into between the parties on such terms as they may agree. The parties shall, before or at the time of entering into each Transaction, agree on the following terms (to the extent applicable to such Transaction):
> \(i\) the identity and nominal value (or quantity, as applicable) of the Purchased Securities;
> \(ii\) the Purchase Date;
> \(iii\) the Purchase Price;
> \(iv\) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is to be an open Transaction, a statement to that effect;
> \(v\) the Pricing Rate;
> \(vi\) the identification of each party as Buyer or Seller;
> \(vii\) any Margin Ratio, Margin Percentage, or other margin terms applicable to the Transaction;
> \(viii\) the Sell Back Price (in the case of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction); and
> \(ix\) such other terms as the parties may agree to be applicable to such Transaction.

**(b) Confirmation.** Upon entering into a Transaction, the Buyer or Seller (as the parties may agree, or, in the absence of such agreement, the Seller) shall promptly deliver to the other party a written Confirmation setting out the terms of such Transaction. Each Confirmation shall specify the relevant terms agreed under sub-paragraph (a) above and such other details as may be required for the proper recording and settlement of the Transaction. The terms of the Confirmation shall be binding on both parties unless the other party objects in writing promptly upon receipt of such Confirmation, and in any event no later than the close of business on the Business Day following receipt thereof. Failure to deliver or object to a Confirmation shall not, however, invalidate or affect the validity of the Transaction.
**(c) Termination of Transactions.**

> \(i\) Subject to the provisions of Paragraph 10, each Transaction shall terminate on the Repurchase Date upon the payment of the Repurchase Price by Seller and the delivery of Equivalent Securities by Buyer. The obligations of the parties to make such payment and delivery shall be subject to the condition that no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing in respect of either party.

> \(ii\) In the case of a Transaction that is an open Transaction (i.e., a Transaction for which no fixed Repurchase Date has been specified), either party may terminate such Transaction by giving notice to the other party on or before a particular Business Day, and the Transaction shall terminate on the date that is the number of Business Days\' notice agreed between the parties (or, if no such number has been agreed, two (2) Business Days) following the date of such notice. The party giving such notice shall specify in such notice the date on which the Transaction is to terminate, and such date shall be the Repurchase Date for the purposes of such Transaction.

**(d) Netting of Deliveries.** If on any date Transactions between the same parties call for the delivery of the same Securities by each party to the other, and if the parties have so agreed (whether in Annex II or otherwise), the delivery obligations of each party under such Transactions may be netted so that only the net deliverer shall be obliged to deliver the net amount of such Securities to the other party on such date. The scope and application of delivery netting shall be as elected or specified in Annex II.
**[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**
**(a) Transaction Exposure.** The \"**Transaction Exposure**\" of a party in respect of a Transaction at any time shall be determined as follows:

> \(i\) if the Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable to the Transaction, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time multiplied by the Margin Ratio (or, as the case may be, the Market Value adjusted for the Margin Percentage). The Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall be the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities (adjusted as aforesaid) exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time;

> \(ii\) if no Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time, and the Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time.
For the purposes of this sub-paragraph, the Repurchase Price at any time shall be the Purchase Price plus the Price Differential accrued to such time.

**(b) Net Exposure.** The \"**Net Exposure**\" of a party shall be determined by aggregating all Transaction Exposures of that party in respect of all outstanding Transactions between the parties, and setting off against such aggregate any Transaction Exposures of the other party, taking into account the Net Value of Margin Provided by each party. The party whose aggregate exposure (after such set-off and adjustment) is a positive amount shall be the party with the Net Exposure.

**(c) Margin Transfers.** If at any time one party has a Net Exposure in excess of any applicable Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount (each as specified in Annex II), such party may, by notice to the other party, require the other party to make a Margin Transfer to it in an amount sufficient to eliminate the Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount). A Margin Transfer may be effected by:
> \(i\) the transfer of Cash Margin in the currency specified in Annex II or otherwise agreed; or

> \(ii\) the transfer of Margin Securities of a type and description acceptable to the party making the demand and falling within the categories of eligible Margin Securities specified in Annex II; or
> \(iii\) such combination of Cash Margin and Margin Securities as the parties may agree.

**(d) Valuation of Margin Securities.** For the purpose of determining the value of any Margin Securities transferred or to be transferred, such Margin Securities shall be valued at their Market Value as at the relevant date, subject to the application of any haircut or discount percentage specified in Annex II in relation to Margin Securities of that type. The value of any Margin Securities after the application of such haircut shall be the value attributed to such Margin Securities for the purposes of calculating Net Exposure.

**(e) Cash Margin.** Cash Margin shall be denominated in such currency as the parties may agree or as specified in Annex II. Interest shall accrue on Cash Margin at the rate and on the basis specified in Annex II, or, if no such rate is specified, at the overnight interbank rate prevailing from time to time in the principal financial centre of the currency of the Cash Margin. The party holding Cash Margin shall pay interest thereon to the party that transferred such Cash Margin in accordance with the terms elected in Annex II.

**(f) Return of Excess Margin.** If at any time the Net Exposure of a party to whom a Margin Transfer has been made is reduced below the Threshold Amount (if any), or if the party that previously had the Net Exposure no longer has such exposure, the party holding the excess Margin Securities or Cash Margin shall, upon demand by the other party, transfer to the other party Equivalent Margin Securities and/or Cash Margin, as the case may be, in an amount sufficient to reduce the Net Value of Margin Provided to an amount not exceeding the current Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount).

**(g) Timing of Margin Transfers.** Any Margin Transfer demanded in accordance with this Paragraph 4 shall be made by the close of business on the next Business Day following the date of the demand or such other time as the parties may agree. If the parties have agreed a different settlement cycle for Margin Transfers in Annex II, such agreed cycle shall apply.

**(h) Disputes Regarding Margin.** If the parties disagree as to the Market Value of any Securities, Cash Margin, or the amount of any Net Exposure, they shall use reasonable efforts to resolve such disagreement in good faith. Pending resolution of any such dispute:
> \(i\) the party upon whom a demand has been made shall transfer the undisputed amount of margin to the other party; and

> \(ii\) the parties shall seek to agree upon the Market Value of the relevant Securities by reference to independent pricing sources, and, failing such agreement, by reference to quotations obtained from not fewer than two independent market-makers or dealers in the relevant Securities. The average of such quotations shall be the Market Value for the purposes of this Paragraph 4.
**[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**

**(a) Buyer\'s Obligation.** Where Income is paid in respect of any Purchased Securities during the Term of a Transaction, Buyer shall, on the relevant Income Payment Date, or on such other date as the parties may agree, pay to Seller an amount equal to the amount of such Income as would have been received by Seller had the Purchased Securities not been the subject of such Transaction.

**(b) Timing of Income Payment.** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, the amount referred to in sub-paragraph (a) above shall be paid on the date on which such Income is paid in respect of the relevant Securities by the issuer or the relevant paying agent. If Income is paid on a day that is not a Business Day, payment shall be made on the next following Business Day.

**(c) Manufactured Payments.** Where any payment under this Paragraph 5 constitutes a \"manufactured payment\" or \"manufactured dividend\" or similar payment for tax or regulatory purposes, the following provisions shall apply:

> \(i\) if Buyer is required by applicable law to withhold or deduct any amount from such payment on account of tax, Buyer shall make the relevant withholding or deduction and shall pay to Seller the net amount remaining after such withholding or deduction;
> \(ii\) unless otherwise agreed in Annex II, Buyer shall not be required to gross up or pay any additional amounts to compensate Seller for any such withholding or deduction; and

> \(iii\) the parties shall cooperate in good faith to minimise any such withholding or deduction and to provide such forms, certificates, or documentation as may be reasonably required by applicable law or regulation.

**(d) Set-off of Income.** Buyer may set off any amount due from Buyer to Seller under this Paragraph 5 against any amount due from Seller to Buyer under any Transaction, provided that both amounts are due and payable on the same date and are denominated in the same currency.

**(e) Buy/Sell Back Transactions.** In the case of Buy/Sell Back Transactions, the treatment of Income shall be as provided in Part 1 of Annex I. The Sell Back Price shall be adjusted to reflect any Income received or receivable during the Term, in accordance with the formula set out in Part 1 of Annex I, and the provisions of this Paragraph 5 shall apply only to the extent specified in Annex I and subject to any elections made in Annex II.
**[Paragraph 6 --- Payment and Transfer]{.underline}**

**(a) Payments.** All payments to be made under this Agreement shall be made in freely available, immediately available, same-day funds in the relevant Contractual Currency. Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, all payments shall be made not later than the time customary in the relevant market for payments in the Contractual Currency on the date on which such payment is due.

**(b) Deliveries of Securities.** All deliveries of Securities to be made under this Agreement shall be made through the clearing system or settlement system agreed between the parties in the relevant Confirmation or in Annex II, or, if no such system is specified, through such system as is customary for the settlement of transactions in such Securities. Deliveries may be made on a free of payment basis or on a delivery versus payment basis, as specified in the relevant Confirmation or as otherwise agreed.

**(c) Set-off and Payment Netting.** Where on any date amounts are due from each party to the other under two or more Transactions, and such amounts are denominated in the same currency, the parties may (and, if so elected in Annex II, shall) net such amounts so that only the net amount shall be payable by the party owing the larger aggregate amount. Each party\'s obligation to pay amounts under this Agreement on any date shall, to the extent of such netting, be discharged and replaced by the obligation of one party to pay the net amount to the other.

**(d) Default Interest.** If either party fails to pay any amount when due under this Agreement, interest shall accrue on such unpaid amount from (and including) the date on which such amount was due to (but excluding) the date of actual payment, at a rate per annum equal to the overnight cost of funding of the Non-Defaulting Party or the party to whom such amount is owed, as reasonably determined by such party, or at such other rate as may be agreed in Annex II. Such interest shall be payable on demand and shall be calculated on the basis of a year of 360 days (or 365 days, as applicable to the relevant currency) and the actual number of days elapsed.

**(e) Currency Conversion.** Where it is necessary for the purposes of this Agreement to convert any amount from one currency to another, such conversion shall be effected at the Spot Rate on the relevant date or, if no Spot Rate is available on such date, on the most recent date on which a Spot Rate is available, and any resulting amount shall be expressed in the Base Currency for the purpose of aggregation, comparison, or netting under this Agreement.
**[Paragraph 7 --- Contractual Currency]{.underline}**

**(a)** Each payment obligation arising under this Agreement shall be satisfied by payment in the Contractual Currency. If, for any reason, a party receives payment in a currency other than the Contractual Currency, and the amount received by such party, upon conversion to the Contractual Currency at the Spot Rate on the date of receipt, is less than the amount due in the Contractual Currency, the paying party shall remain liable for the shortfall. If the amount received upon such conversion exceeds the amount due, the receiving party shall not be obliged to refund the excess, but may, at its discretion, credit such excess against future payment obligations of the paying party.

**(b)** The obligation to pay any shortfall arising under sub-paragraph (a) above shall constitute a separate and independent obligation of the paying party, enforceable irrespective of any judgment or order obtained or made in respect of the original payment obligation or any other obligation under this Agreement. This obligation shall not be affected by any judgment or order that may be expressed or converted into a currency other than the Contractual Currency.

**(c)** For the purposes of this Paragraph 7, the conversion rate to be applied shall be the Spot Rate on the date on which conversion is made. Where multiple conversions are required, each such conversion shall be effected at the Spot Rate prevailing on the date of the relevant conversion.
**[Paragraph 8 --- Substitution]{.underline}**

**(a) Right to Request Substitution.** Subject to the terms of this Paragraph 8, Seller may at any time during the Term of a Transaction request Buyer to accept substitute securities (\"**New Purchased Securities**\") in place of all or any part of the existing Purchased Securities, and Buyer shall not unreasonably withhold or delay its consent to such substitution. Buyer shall be entitled to refuse consent to a substitution if the proposed New Purchased Securities are not reasonably acceptable to Buyer having regard to the creditworthiness of the issuer, the liquidity of the market for such securities, the type or category of securities, or any other commercially reasonable ground.

**(b) Mechanics of Substitution.** If Buyer consents to a substitution, the substitution shall be effected by the simultaneous transfer by Seller to Buyer of the New Purchased Securities and the transfer by Buyer to Seller of the existing Purchased Securities (or such portion thereof as is being substituted), or by such other arrangement as the parties may agree. Upon such substitution, all references in this Agreement and in the relevant Confirmation to \"Purchased Securities\" shall, in respect of the relevant Transaction, be deemed to refer to the New Purchased Securities, and the terms of the Transaction shall be adjusted accordingly.

**(c) Equivalent Value.** The New Purchased Securities shall have a Market Value as at the date of substitution that is substantially the same as (or, if so agreed between the parties, not less than) the Market Value of the Purchased Securities they replace, determined as at the same date. If the Market Value of the New Purchased Securities is less than the Market Value of the Purchased Securities being replaced, Seller shall transfer additional Securities or Cash Margin in an amount sufficient to eliminate the shortfall, or the parties shall agree such other adjustments to the Transaction as are appropriate.

**(d) Effect on Margin.** Following any substitution, the margin obligations of the parties under Paragraph 4 shall be recalculated by reference to the Market Value of the New Purchased Securities. Any Margin Transfer demand outstanding prior to such substitution shall be adjusted accordingly, and any Margin Transfer already made shall be taken into account in the recalculated margin position.
**[Paragraph 9 --- Representations]{.underline}**

**(a) Power and Authority.** Each party represents and warrants to the other party (on the date of this Agreement and as at each date specified in sub-paragraph (f) below) that it has the power, authority, and legal right to enter into this Agreement and each Transaction under this Agreement, and to perform its obligations hereunder and thereunder.

**(b) Due Authorisation.** Each party represents and warrants that the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction has been and will be duly authorised by all necessary action (corporate, regulatory, or otherwise) on the part of such party.
**(c) No Violation.** Each party represents and warrants that neither the execution and delivery of this Agreement nor the entering into or performance of any Transaction will:

> \(i\) violate, contravene, or conflict with any law, regulation, order, judgment, or decree of any court or governmental, regulatory, or supervisory authority applicable to or binding on such party or any of its assets;

> \(ii\) violate, contravene, or conflict with any provision of such party\'s constitutional documents (including, without limitation, its articles of association, bylaws, or certificate of incorporation); or
> \(iii\) result in a breach of, or constitute a default under, any agreement, instrument, or obligation to which such party is a party or by which any of its assets are bound.

**(d) Binding Obligations.** Each party represents and warrants that this Agreement and each Transaction constitute legal, valid, and binding obligations of such party, enforceable against it in accordance with their respective terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganisation, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to general principles of equity.

**(e) Title.** Seller represents and warrants to Buyer, in respect of each Transaction, that at the time of transfer of Purchased Securities to Buyer on the Purchase Date, Seller has the full and unqualified right to sell and transfer such Securities free and clear of any lien, charge, claim, security interest, encumbrance, right of set-off, or any other adverse interest or claim of any third party.

**(f) Repetition.** The representations and warranties made by each party under this Paragraph 9 shall be deemed to be repeated by such party on each Purchase Date, on each date on which a Transaction is outstanding, and on each date on which a Margin Transfer is made or received.
**[Paragraph 10 --- Events of Default; Remedies]{.underline}**
**(a) Events of Default.** Each of the following events shall constitute an \"**Event of Default**\" with respect to a party (the \"**Defaulting Party**\"):

> \(i\) **Failure to Pay Purchase Price or Repurchase Price.** Buyer fails to pay the Purchase Price on the Purchase Date or Seller fails to pay the Repurchase Price on the Repurchase Date, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);

> \(ii\) **Failure to Deliver Securities.** Seller fails to deliver the Purchased Securities on the Purchase Date or Buyer fails to deliver Equivalent Securities on the Repurchase Date, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);

> \(iii\) **Failure to Pay Income.** Buyer fails to pay any amount due under Paragraph 5 (Income Payments) when due, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);

> \(iv\) **Failure to Make Margin Transfer.** A party fails to make a Margin Transfer as required under Paragraph 4 when due, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);
> \(v\) **Act of Insolvency.** An Act of Insolvency occurs in respect of either party;

> \(vi\) **Breach of Representation.** Any representation made by a party under Paragraph 9 proves to have been incorrect or misleading in any material respect when made or when deemed to have been repeated;

> \(vii\) **Failure to Perform Other Obligations.** A party fails to perform any other obligation under this Agreement and such failure is not remedied within thirty (30) calendar days (or such other period as may be specified in Annex II) after written notice from the other party specifying such failure and requiring its remedy; and
> \(viii\) **Additional Events of Default.** Any other event specified in Annex II as an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
**(b) Consequences of an Event of Default.**

> \(i\) Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default (other than an Act of Insolvency in respect of which automatic Early Termination applies), the Non-Defaulting Party may, at any time thereafter while such Event of Default is continuing, by written notice to the Defaulting Party (a \"Default Notice\"), designate a date (the \"Close-out Date\"), not earlier than the date of such notice and not later than twenty (20) days after the date of such notice, as the date on which all outstanding Transactions between the parties shall be terminated.

> \(ii\) All outstanding Transactions shall, on the Close-out Date (or, if earlier, the date of service of the Default Notice if no specific later date is designated), be terminated, and no further deliveries or payments shall be required to be made under any terminated Transaction except as provided in this Paragraph 10.

> \(iii\) If \"Automatic Early Termination\" is specified as applicable to a party in Annex II, then, upon the occurrence of an Act of Insolvency in respect of such party, all outstanding Transactions shall be terminated automatically, without the requirement for the delivery of a Default Notice, as of the time immediately preceding the occurrence of such Act of Insolvency, and the date of such automatic termination shall be the Close-out Date.
**(c) Close-out Calculation / Default Valuation.**

> \(i\) Following the designation of a Close-out Date (or the occurrence of automatic Early Termination), the Non-Defaulting Party shall determine, as at the Close-out Date, the Default Market Value of all Equivalent Securities that would have been deliverable, and of all Purchased Securities that would have been deliverable, under each terminated Transaction.
> \(ii\) The Default Market Value of any Securities shall be determined by the Non-Defaulting Party as follows:

> \(A\) The Non-Defaulting Party shall use reasonable efforts to obtain, within five (5) Business Days of the Close-out Date (or such other period as may be specified in Annex II), firm quotations from not fewer than the number of dealers specified in Annex II (or, if no number is specified, two (2) dealers) in the Appropriate Market for the sale or purchase (as appropriate) of such Securities in an amount and on terms reflecting the terms of the relevant Transaction.
> \(B\) The Default Market Value shall be:

> \(1\) if such quotations are obtained, the arithmetic mean of such quotations (exclusive of any accrued but unpaid Income and after deduction of any costs, commissions, or other expenses that would be incurred in connection with such sale or purchase); or

> \(2\) if, despite using reasonable efforts, the Non-Defaulting Party is unable to obtain a sufficient number of firm quotations within the specified period, the Market Value of such Securities on the Close-out Date (or, if the Close-out Date is not a Business Day, on the immediately preceding Business Day), as determined in good faith by the Non-Defaulting Party having regard to any available pricing sources, recent transactions in similar Securities, and prevailing market conditions.

> \(iii\) For each terminated Transaction, the Non-Defaulting Party shall calculate the net amount that would be payable by one party to the other upon termination of such Transaction, taking into account the Default Market Value of the relevant Securities, the Repurchase Price, any Cash Margin and Margin Securities transferred and not returned, any accrued but unpaid Income, and any other amounts due but unpaid under such Transaction.

> \(iv\) The Non-Defaulting Party shall then aggregate all such net amounts across all terminated Transactions and set off amounts due from each party to the other, so as to produce a single net amount (the \"**Net Close-out Amount**\") payable by one party (the \"Net Paying Party\") to the other.

**(d) Payment of Net Amount.** The Net Paying Party shall pay the Net Close-out Amount to the other party, denominated in the Base Currency, on the Business Day following the date on which such amount is determined, or on such later date as may be required for the calculation to be completed.

**(e) Transaction Costs.** The Defaulting Party shall be liable for and shall pay to the Non-Defaulting Party all reasonable Transaction Costs incurred by the Non-Defaulting Party in connection with the termination of Transactions, the close-out calculation, and the enforcement of its rights under this Paragraph 10. Transaction Costs shall be added to the Net Close-out Amount payable by the Defaulting Party, or deducted from any Net Close-out Amount payable to the Defaulting Party, as the case may be.

**(f) Interest on Unpaid Amounts.** If the Net Paying Party fails to pay the Net Close-out Amount on the date it is due, interest shall accrue on such unpaid amount from (and including) the Close-out Date to (but excluding) the date of actual payment, at the default rate of interest specified in Paragraph 6(d).

**(g) Preservation of Other Rights.** The rights and remedies of the Non-Defaulting Party under this Paragraph 10 are without prejudice to, and in addition to, any other rights or remedies that the Non-Defaulting Party may have, whether under this Agreement, at law, in equity, or otherwise.

**(h) Single Agreement.** The parties acknowledge and agree that all Transactions entered into under this Agreement are entered into in reliance on the fact that this Agreement and all such Transactions form together a single agreement between the parties, and the parties would not otherwise enter into any Transaction. The right of close-out netting provided for in this Paragraph 10 is an integral and essential part of this Agreement.
**[Paragraph 11 --- Tax Event]{.underline}**

**(a) Withholding and Deduction.** All payments to be made by either party under this Agreement or under any Transaction shall be made without any withholding or deduction for or on account of any tax, levy, duty, charge, fee, or impost of any nature whatsoever now or hereafter imposed, levied, collected, withheld, or assessed by any governmental, fiscal, or taxing authority, unless such withholding or deduction is required by applicable law.
**(b) Gross-up Obligation.** If either party is required by applicable law to make any withholding or deduction from any payment due under this Agreement, such party shall:
> \(i\) promptly notify the other party of such requirement;
> \(ii\) pay to the relevant governmental, fiscal, or taxing authority the full amount required to be withheld or deducted;

> \(iii\) subject to the elections made in Annex II and to the customary exceptions set forth below, pay to the other party such additional amount as may be necessary to ensure that the net amount received by the other party (after giving effect to such withholding or deduction, and after giving effect to any withholding or deduction applicable to any additional amounts payable under this sub-paragraph) is equal to the full amount that would have been received by the other party had no such withholding or deduction been required.

The customary exceptions to the gross-up obligation include: (A) any withholding or deduction attributable to the failure of the receiving party to provide such forms, certificates, or documentation as may be reasonably required by applicable law or by the paying party in order to establish an exemption from, or reduction of, such withholding or deduction; (B) any withholding or deduction attributable to a connection between the receiving party and the jurisdiction of the taxing authority imposing the withholding, other than a connection arising solely from the entering into of this Agreement or any Transaction; and (C) any other exceptions agreed in Annex II.

**(c) Tax Representations.** Each party makes the tax representations set out in Annex II (if any) applicable to that party. Such representations shall be deemed to be repeated on each date on which a Transaction is entered into and on each date on which a payment is made under this Agreement.

**(d) Tax Event Termination.** If, as a result of a change in any applicable law, regulation, or treaty (or in the interpretation or administration thereof) occurring after the date on which a Transaction is entered into, a party becomes obliged to make a withholding or deduction from any payment under such Transaction (and, in consequence, becomes obliged to gross up such payment under sub-paragraph (b) above), then either party may, by written notice to the other, designate a date on which the affected Transaction (or, if elected by the terminating party, all outstanding Transactions) shall terminate. Such termination shall be without prejudice to any amounts accrued or payable prior to the date of termination. The terms and conditions applicable to termination upon a tax event shall be as negotiated and set out in Annex II.
**[Paragraph 12 --- Interest]{.underline}**

Interest shall be payable on Cash Margin held by either party at the rate and on the basis specified in Annex II, or, if no rate or basis is specified, at the overnight interbank rate prevailing from time to time in the principal financial centre of the currency of the relevant Cash Margin. Interest on Cash Margin shall accrue from (and including) the date of transfer of such Cash Margin to (but excluding) the date of its return, and shall be payable on demand or at such intervals as the parties may agree. Interest on late payments shall accrue at the rate specified in Paragraph 6(d) and shall be calculated on the day count basis applicable to the relevant currency in accordance with prevailing market convention, or as otherwise elected in Annex II.
**[Paragraph 13 --- Single Agreement]{.underline}**

The parties acknowledge and agree that all Transactions entered into under this Agreement are entered into in reliance on the fact that this Agreement (including, for the avoidance of doubt, Annex I, Annex II, and all Confirmations) and all such Transactions together constitute a single, integrated agreement between the parties. Each party acknowledges that it would not otherwise enter into any Transaction, and the close-out netting provisions of Paragraph 10 and all related provisions constitute an integral and essential part of this Agreement. The single agreement nature of this Agreement shall be relevant for the purposes of all applicable laws, including insolvency, bankruptcy, and netting laws.
**[Paragraph 14 --- Notices]{.underline}**

31: **[Paragraph 1 --- Applicability]{.underline}**
32: 
33: **1.1** This Agreement is a Global Master Repurchase Agreement in the form published by the International Capital Market Association in 2011 (the \"**2011 ICMA GMRA**\"), as supplemented by Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions) in the form published by ICMA in 2011 (the \"**2011 Annex I**\") and by Annex II (Elections, Supplements, and Amendments) attached hereto .

43: **[Paragraph 2 --- Definitions]{.underline}**

45: **2.1** Unless otherwise defined in this Agreement or the context otherwise requires, capitalised terms used in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, which definitions are hereby incorporated by reference as if set out in full herein.
46: 
47: **2.2** In addition to the definitions set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, the following additional defined terms are introduced in Annex II and, to the extent set out therein, shall apply for the purposes of this Agreement:
48: 
49: > \(a\) \"**Eligible Collateral**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(c).
50: >
51: > \(b\) \"**Eligible Sovereign Securities**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(a).
52: >
53: > \(c\) \"**Eligible Corporate Securities**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(b).
54: >
55: > \(d\) \"**Haircut**\" or \"**Haircut Percentage**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 4.
56: >
57: > \(e\) \"**Margin Threshold**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 5.
58: >
59: > \(f\) \"**Net Exposure Cap**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 6.
60: >
61: > \(g\) \"**Cross-Default Threshold**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 10(c).
62: >
63: > \(h\) \"**Act of Insolvency Grace Period**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 11(b).
64: >
65: > \(i\) \"**Equivalent Securities**\" has the meaning given in the 2011 ICMA GMRA; for the avoidance of doubt, securities of the same ISIN, nominal amount, and coupon shall be deemed equivalent for the purposes of substitution and return under this Agreement.
66: 
67: **2.3** In the event of any inconsistency between a definition contained in Annex II and a definition of the same term contained in the body of this Agreement, the 2011 ICMA GMRA, or the 2011 Annex I, the definition in Annex II shall prevail.

69: **2.4** \"**Base Currency**\" means United States Dollars (USD). All calculations of Transaction Exposure, Margin Deficit, Margin Excess, Net Exposure, and all other amounts required to be computed in a single currency under this Agreement shall be calculated in, or converted into, the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange prevailing at the relevant time of determination, as reasonably determined by Buyer.
70: 
71: **2.5** \"**Business Day**\" means a day (other than a Saturday or Sunday) on which commercial banks are open for general business (including dealings in foreign exchange and foreign currency deposits) in both London, England and New York, New York, United States of America. For the avoidance of doubt, any day that is a public holiday observed by the Bank of England in London or by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York shall not constitute a Business Day for the purposes of this Agreement.
72: 
73: **2.6** For the avoidance of doubt, where any term is defined in both this Paragraph 2 and in Annex II, the Annex II definition shall govern.

75: **2.7** \"**Transaction Exposure**\" shall, for the purposes of this Agreement, be calculated by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities as of the close of business on the Business Day immediately preceding the relevant date of determination, consistent with the margin call cut-off mechanics set out in Annex II, Section 7.

77: **[Paragraph 3 --- Initiation; Confirmations]{.underline}**
78: 
79: **3.1** Each Transaction shall be entered into by telephone, electronic messaging (including Bloomberg messaging, SWIFT, or electronic mail), or such other method as may be agreed between the parties from time to time. Each party shall designate one or more authorised persons who shall have authority to enter into Transactions on its behalf, and each party shall provide the other with a written list of such authorised persons, updated from time to time as necessary.
80: 
81: **3.2** Each Transaction shall be evidenced by a Confirmation in writing delivered by Buyer or Seller (as agreed between the parties for such purpose) by close of business on the Business Day following the Purchase Date. A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail, facsimile, or through an electronic trade confirmation platform used by both parties. Each party shall use reasonable efforts to respond promptly to any Confirmation received and to notify the other party of any discrepancy in the terms set out therein.
82: 
83: **3.3** The Confirmation for each Transaction shall specify, at a minimum, the following:
84: 
85: > \(a\) the Purchase Date;
86: >
87: > \(b\) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is an open Transaction or an \"on demand\" Transaction, a statement to that effect;
88: >
89: > \(c\) the Purchased Securities, including the International Securities Identification Number (ISIN), the nominal amount or face value, and a description (including issuer name, coupon rate, and maturity date) of such securities;
90: >
91: > \(d\) the Purchase Price;
92: >
93: > \(e\) the Repurchase Price or, alternatively, the Pricing Rate and the basis for computation of the Repurchase Price;
94: >
95: > \(f\) Buyer\'s account details for the receipt of Purchased Securities and for the payment of the Purchase Price;
96: >
97: > \(g\) Seller\'s account details for the delivery of Purchased Securities and for the receipt of the Purchase Price;
98: >
99: > \(h\) the applicable Haircut Percentage;
100: >
101: > \(i\) any additional terms specifically agreed between the parties for that Transaction, including any special conditions, additional collateral requirements, or modifications to the standard terms of this Agreement applicable solely to that Transaction.
102: 
103: **3.4** A Confirmation shall, upon delivery, supplement, form part of, and be subject to this Agreement. Together with this Agreement, each Confirmation shall evidence a complete and binding agreement between the parties with respect to the Transaction to which it relates. In the event of any inconsistency between the terms of a Confirmation and the terms of this Agreement (including Annex I and Annex II), the terms of the Confirmation shall prevail with respect to the Transaction to which such Confirmation relates, unless the Confirmation expressly provides otherwise.
104: 
105: **3.5** The failure by either party to deliver a Confirmation with respect to a Transaction shall not affect the validity or enforceability of that Transaction, provided that the terms thereof have been agreed between the parties. Where a Confirmation is not delivered by the deadline specified in Paragraph 3.2, the Transaction shall nonetheless be valid and governed by this Agreement, and either party may require the other to deliver a Confirmation at any time thereafter.
106: 
107: **3.6** A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail (including as a PDF attachment), and a Confirmation so delivered shall have the same force and effect as a signed original.

109: **[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**
110: 
111: **Paragraph 4(a) --- Margin Deficit / Margin Excess**
112: 
113: **4.1** The parties shall, on each Business Day (or at such other intervals as may be agreed), mark to market all outstanding Transactions by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities and the Transaction Exposure in respect of each Transaction, each calculated in the Base Currency.
114: 
115: **4.2** If at any time the aggregate Cash Margin (if any) held by or on behalf of Buyer, together with the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), is less than the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Deficit**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Deficit shall be equal to the shortfall, calculated in the Base Currency.
116: 
117: **4.3** If at any time the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), together with any Cash Margin held by or on behalf of Buyer, exceeds the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Excess**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Excess shall be equal to the surplus, calculated in the Base Currency.
118: 
119: **Paragraph 4(b) --- Delivery Amount / Return Amount**
120: 
121: **4.4** Upon the existence of a Margin Deficit, Buyer may by notice to Seller (a \"**Margin Call**\") require Seller to transfer to Buyer Additional Purchased Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) in an amount sufficient to eliminate such Margin Deficit (the aggregate amount so required, the \"**Delivery Amount**\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Delivery Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(a) (being \$500,000 as of the date hereof).
122: 
123: **4.5** Upon the existence of a Margin Excess, Seller may by notice to Buyer (also a \"**Margin Call**\") require Buyer to transfer to Seller Equivalent Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) sufficient to eliminate such Margin Excess (the aggregate amount so required, the \"**Return Amount**\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Return Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(b) (being \$500,000 as of the date hereof).
124: 
125: **4.6** Any Additional Purchased Securities transferred by Seller to Buyer pursuant to a Margin Call must constitute Eligible Collateral, and the Market Value of such Additional Purchased Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) shall be at least equal to the Delivery Amount.
126: 
127: **Paragraph 4(c) --- Margin Call Timing**
128: 
129: **4.7** A Margin Call must be received by the other party by the margin call cut-off time specified in Annex II, Section 7 (being 10:00 a.m. London time as of the date hereof) in order for the resulting transfer to be required on that same Business Day.
130: 
131: **4.8** If a Margin Call is received before the cut-off time on a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on that same Business Day.
132: 
133: **4.9** If a Margin Call is received at or after the cut-off time on a Business Day, or on a day that is not a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on the next following Business Day.
134: 
135: **4.10** For the purposes of this Paragraph 4(c), a Margin Call shall be deemed to have been \"received\" when it is actually received by the recipient at the address, facsimile number, or electronic mail address specified in Annex II, Section 14 for the giving of notices. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to acknowledge receipt of a Margin Call promptly upon receipt.
136: 
137: **Paragraph 4(d) --- Haircuts**
138: 
139: **4.11** The applicable Haircut Percentage for each category of Eligible Collateral is as specified in Annex II, Section 4, and is summarised as follows:
140: 
141:   -----------------------------------------------------------------------
142:   **Category**                        **Haircut Percentage**
143:   ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
144:   Eligible Sovereign Securities       1.5% (the \"Sovereign Haircut\")
145: 
146:   Eligible Corporate Securities       3.5% (the \"Corporate Haircut\")
147:   -----------------------------------------------------------------------
148: 
149: **4.12** The Transaction Exposure in respect of any Transaction shall be calculated by applying the relevant Haircut Percentage to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities. The Haircut Percentage shall be applied in the manner set out in Annex II, Section 4, such that the Purchase Price for a Transaction shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of the Purchased Securities by one (1) plus the applicable Haircut Percentage (expressed as a decimal).
150: 
151: **4.13** Buyer reserves the right, upon not less than five (5) Business Days\' prior written notice to Seller, to revise the applicable Haircut Percentage for any category of Eligible Collateral in connection with future Transactions, provided that (a) any such revision shall apply only to Transactions entered into after the effective date of such revision and shall not affect the terms of any Transaction already outstanding, and (b) any such revision shall be made in good faith and on a commercially reasonable basis, having regard to prevailing market conditions, the credit quality of the relevant class of securities, and Buyer\'s internal risk management policies.
152: 
153: **[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**
154: 
155: **5.1** Where Purchased Securities are held by Buyer on a record date, ex-dividend date, or other relevant date for any distribution of Income (including, without limitation, any coupon, interest payment, dividend, principal repayment (other than at maturity), or other distribution payable in respect of such Purchased Securities), Buyer shall, on the next Business Day following the date on which Buyer receives or is credited with such Income, pay to Seller an amount equal to such Income (a \"**Manufactured Payment**\").
156: 
157: **5.2** Manufactured Payments shall be made in the currency in which the relevant Income payment is denominated and shall be paid to the account designated by Seller for the receipt of funds in such currency, as specified in the relevant Confirmation or as otherwise notified by Seller to Buyer in writing.
158: 
159: **5.3** All Manufactured Payments shall be made net of any applicable withholding tax, deduction, or other amount required to be withheld or deducted by Buyer under applicable law. If Buyer is required by applicable law to make any such withholding or deduction, the provisions of Paragraph 11 (Tax) shall apply with respect to any obligation of Buyer to gross up such payment.

161: **5.4** For the avoidance of doubt, the obligation to make a Manufactured Payment arises regardless of whether Buyer has actually received the relevant Income payment from the issuer of the Purchased Securities. Buyer\'s obligation to make the Manufactured Payment is an independent obligation under this Agreement and shall not be conditional upon Buyer\'s receipt of the underlying Income.
162: 
163: **5.5** In respect of any partial coupon period, the Manufactured Payment shall be calculated on an actual/actual (ICMA) day-count basis for Eligible Sovereign Securities and a 30/360 basis for Eligible Corporate Securities, unless otherwise specified in the relevant Confirmation.

171: **6.2** All transfers of Securities required to be made under this Agreement (including the initial transfer of Purchased Securities, the transfer of Additional Purchased Securities, the return of Equivalent Securities, and the transfer of Alternative Securities upon substitution) shall be made through the applicable settlement system, as follows:

175: > \(b\) For USD-denominated Eligible Collateral: **The Depository Trust Company (DTC)**, in accordance with the rules and procedures of DTC as in effect from time to time.

177: **6.3** Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses in connection with the settlement of Securities through the applicable settlement system, including any fees or charges imposed by the settlement system operator, the relevant custodian, or any intermediary in the settlement chain, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the parties.

179: **6.4** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties for a specific Transaction, all deliveries of Securities shall be made on a delivery-versus-payment (DvP) basis. 181: **Paragraph 6(b) --- Netting**

183: **6.5** As elected in Annex II, Section 8, Paragraph 7(b) of this Agreement (settlement netting for obligations in the same currency falling due on the same settlement date) shall apply. The parties agree that, where on any Business Day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and on the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether under Paragraph 4, Paragraph 5, or otherwise under this Agreement), such obligations shall be subject to the netting provisions set out in Paragraph 7 below.

187: **Paragraph 7(a) --- Payment Netting**
188: 
189: **7.1** The standard payment netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. Accordingly, where on any Business Day amounts would be payable by each party to the other in the same currency and on the same value date, the mutual obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount. Such single net payment shall be made by the party owing the net amount on the relevant value date in the manner specified in Paragraph 6(a).
190: 
191: **Paragraph 7(b) --- Close-out Netting / Settlement Netting**
192: 
193: **7.2** **Elected.** If on any day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and in respect of the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether pursuant to Paragraph 4 (Margin Maintenance), Paragraph 5 (Income Payments), Paragraph 10 (Events of Default), or otherwise under this Agreement), the obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and, if the aggregate amount payable by one party exceeds the aggregate amount payable by the other party, replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount.
194: 
195: **7.3** The single net amount determined in accordance with Paragraph 7.2 above shall be payable in the relevant currency on the relevant settlement date, and only the net amount shall be required to be paid by the party owing such amount. The other party shall have no obligation to make any payment in respect of the amounts so netted.
196: 
197: **7.4** Each party represents that the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7 are enforceable against it in all relevant jurisdictions, including the jurisdiction of its incorporation or organisation, the jurisdiction of its principal office, and any other jurisdiction in which it conducts business or holds assets. Each party agrees to take such steps and execute such documents as may reasonably be required to give effect to the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7.

200: 
201: **8.1** Subject to the provisions of Annex II, Section 9, Seller may from time to time during the term of any Transaction effect a substitution of Alternative Securities for all or any part of the Purchased Securities in that Transaction.
202: 
203: **8.2** Any notice of substitution shall be made by Seller to Buyer in writing (including by electronic mail) and shall specify the Purchased Securities to be replaced, the proposed Alternative Securities, and the proposed date on which the substitution is to take effect. 205: **8.3** Seller shall give Buyer not less than one (1) Business Day\'s prior notice of any proposed substitution. No consent of Buyer shall be required.

207: **8.4** The substitution shall be effected on the Business Day specified in Seller\'s notice by the simultaneous transfer of the Alternative Securities by Seller to Buyer (or to Buyer\'s account at the relevant settlement system) and the transfer of the relevant Purchased Securities by Buyer to Seller (or to Seller\'s account at the relevant settlement system), in each case in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 6.

209: **8.5** Any Alternative Securities transferred by Seller must qualify as Eligible Collateral and must satisfy all of the eligibility criteria set out in Annex II, Section 3.
210: 
211: **8.6** Upon completion of a substitution, the Alternative Securities shall become the Purchased Securities for all purposes of the relevant Transaction, and the Confirmation for such Transaction shall be deemed to have been amended accordingly.

214: 
215: **9.1** Each party represents and warrants to the other, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date on which it enters into a Transaction, that:

220: >
221: > \(c\) **Governmental and Regulatory Approvals.** All governmental and regulatory consents, approvals, authorisations, registrations, filings, and notices that are necessary for the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction have been obtained or made and are in full force and effect.
222: >
223: > \(d\) **Binding Obligations.** This Agreement and each Transaction constitute legal, valid, and binding obligations of such party, enforceable against it in accordance with their respective terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganisation, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to equitable principles of general applicability.

Buyer further represents that all such authorisations are in full force and effect, that it is not subject to any suspension, revocation, or restriction on any such authorisation that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and that it is in compliance in all material respects with all applicable requirements of FINMA, the PRA, and the FCA. 235: **[Paragraph 10 --- Events of Default]{.underline}**

237: **Paragraph 10(a) --- Standard Events of Default**
238: 
239: **10.1** Each of the following shall constitute an \"**Event of Default**\" with respect to a party (the \"**Defaulting Party**\"):
240: 
241: > \(i\) **Failure to Pay or Deliver.** Such party fails to pay any amount or deliver any Securities when due under this Agreement or any Transaction (including, without limitation, any Purchase Price, Repurchase Price, Cash Margin, Manufactured Payment, or margin transfer), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party. For the avoidance of doubt, \"failure to pay\" includes a failure to make a Manufactured Payment under Paragraph 5. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a failure caused solely by an administrative or operational error in a settlement system shall not constitute an Event of Default under this sub-paragraph (i) if such failure is cured within two (2) Business Days of the paying party becoming aware of such failure.
242: >
243: > \(ii\) **Failure to Comply with Margin Call.** Such party fails to comply with a Margin Call made in accordance with Paragraph 4 (including any failure to transfer Additional Purchased Securities, Equivalent Securities, or Cash Margin in the amount and by the time required), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party.
244: >
245: > \(iii\) **Breach of Representation.** Any representation or warranty made or deemed repeated by such party under Paragraph 9 (or elsewhere in this Agreement) is materially incorrect or misleading when made or when deemed repeated.
246: >
247: > \(iv\) **Failure to Perform Other Obligations.** Such party fails to perform any other material obligation under this Agreement and, if such failure is capable of remedy, such failure continues for thirty (30) calendar days after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party specifying the nature of the failure and requiring its remedy.
248: >
249: > \(v\) **Act of Insolvency.** An Act of Insolvency occurs with respect to such party, as defined in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and as supplemented by Annex II, Section 11.
250: >
251: > \(vi\) **Cross-Default.** A Cross-Default occurs with respect to such party, as defined and supplemented by Annex II, Section 10.
252: >
253: > \(vii\) **Material Adverse Change in Regulatory Status.** A material adverse change in the regulatory status of such party occurs, including, without limitation, the suspension or revocation of such party\'s broker-dealer registration, banking licence, or authorisation to carry on regulated activities, or the imposition of any restriction on such party\'s regulated activities that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement.
254: 
255: **Paragraph 10(b) --- Consequences of an Event of Default**
256: 
257: **10.2** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default with respect to a Defaulting Party, the Non-Defaulting Party may, at any time thereafter, by written notice to the Defaulting Party (or, in the case of an Act of Insolvency, without the requirement for any notice if the Act of Insolvency constitutes an ipso facto trigger as set out in Annex II, Section 11(b)), designate an \"**Early Termination Date**\" in respect of all (but not less than all) outstanding Transactions.

261: **10.4** The standard close-out netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. The Default Market Value of each Transaction shall be determined in accordance with Paragraph 10(d) of the 2011 ICMA GMRA, and the amounts so determined shall be aggregated and netted in accordance with the provisions thereof to produce a single net amount payable by one party to the other. The party owing such net amount shall pay it to the other party on the Early Termination Date (or, if such date is not a Business Day, on the next following Business Day) in the Base Currency.
262: 
263: **10.5** The rights and remedies of the Non-Defaulting Party under this Paragraph 10 are in addition to, and without prejudice to, any other rights or remedies available to it under this Agreement, at law, or in equity.

Each party shall be responsible for its own tax obligations arising in connection with this Agreement and any Transaction, and each party shall provide to the other party such tax forms, certificates, and other documentation as the other party may reasonably request in order to establish any available exemption from, or reduction in the rate of, any withholding or deduction for or on account of tax.
270: 
271: **11.2** Each party represents that it has provided, or will provide promptly upon request, accurate and complete information regarding its tax status, residency, and any applicable tax identification numbers to the other party, and will promptly notify the other party of any change in such information. Each party shall, upon request by the other party, deliver such tax forms and documentation (including IRS Forms W-8BEN-E or W-9, as applicable) as may be reasonably necessary to establish entitlement to any exemption from or reduction of withholding tax.
272: 
273: **Paragraph 11(b) --- Tax Gross-Up**
274: 
275: **11.3** **Elected.** If either party (the \"**Tax Payor**\") is required by any applicable law, regulation, or governmental or regulatory authority to make any deduction or withholding from any payment due under this Agreement (including, without limitation, any Manufactured Payment, any payment of the Purchase Price or the Repurchase Price, any payment of Cash Margin, or any payment of a close-out amount), the Tax Payor shall pay such additional amounts (the \"**Tax Gross-Up Amounts**\") as may be necessary to ensure that the other party (the \"**Tax Payee**\") receives the full amount that it would have received had no such deduction or withholding been required.
276: 
277: **11.4** The Tax Payor\'s obligation to pay Tax Gross-Up Amounts shall not apply to the extent that the deduction or withholding arises as a result of (a) the Tax Payee\'s failure to provide any tax form, certificate, or other documentation reasonably requested by the Tax Payor, (b) the Tax Payee\'s failure to comply with any applicable procedural requirement for claiming an exemption from or reduction in the rate of withholding, or (c) a change in tax residency of the Tax Payee after the date of this Agreement.
278: 
279: **11.5** **Cure Period.** If a Tax Payor fails to pay any Tax Gross-Up Amount required under this Paragraph 11(b), the Tax Payee shall give written notice of such failure to the Tax Payor. The Tax Payor shall have a cure period of five (5) Business Days from receipt of such notice within which to pay the outstanding Tax Gross-Up Amount in full. Failure of the Tax Payor to cure such failure within such five (5) Business Day period shall constitute an Event of Default with respect to the Tax Payor, and the Tax Payee may thereafter exercise its rights under Paragraph 10(b) of this Agreement.

282: 
283: **12.1** The standard interest provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. If any amount payable by a party under this Agreement is not paid on the date on which it falls due, interest shall accrue on such unpaid amount from (and including) the due date to (but excluding) the date of actual payment, at a rate per annum equal to the overnight rate for the relevant currency (as determined by the Non-Defaulting Party in a commercially reasonable manner, by reference to the rate published by the relevant central bank or an equivalent interbank overnight rate source) plus one percent (1%) per annum. For the purposes of this Paragraph 12, the \"overnight rate\" for USD shall be the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) as published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York; for GBP, the Sterling Overnight Index Average (SONIA) as published by the Bank of England; and for EUR, the Euro Short-Term Rate (€STR) as published by the European Central Bank.
284: 
285: **12.2** Interest accruing under this Paragraph 12 shall be calculated on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed and a 360-day year (in the case of USD and EUR) or a 365-day year (in the case of GBP), and shall be payable on demand.
286: 
287: **12.3** The payment of interest under this Paragraph 12 shall be without prejudice to any other rights or remedies available to the Non-Defaulting Party under this Agreement or at law.

313: **16.1** **Non-assignability.** Neither party may assign, transfer, charge, or otherwise dispose of any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party. 333: **17.6** For the avoidance of doubt, this clause confers non-exclusive, and not exclusive, jurisdiction.

341: **18.3** The rights and remedies provided in this Agreement are cumulative and not exclusive of any rights or remedies provided by law.
