35: **1.1** This Agreement is a Global Master Repurchase Agreement in the form published by the International Capital Market Association in 2011 (the \"**2011 ICMA GMRA**\"), as supplemented by Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions) in the form published by ICMA in 2011 (the \"**2011 Annex I**\") and by Annex II (Elections, Supplements, and Amendments) attached hereto .
36: 
37: **1.2** This Agreement, together with Annex I, Annex II, each Confirmation exchanged between the parties, and any other schedules, appendices, or annexes expressly incorporated herein by reference, shall together constitute a single agreement between Buyer and Seller (collectively, the \"**Agreement**\"). Each of the parties acknowledges that all Transactions entered into on or after the date of this Agreement are entered into in reliance on the fact that this Agreement, Annex I, Annex II, and all Confirmations form a single agreement between the parties.
38: 
39: **1.3** Each Transaction entered into between the parties on or after the date of this Agreement shall be governed by and subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. In the event of any inconsistency between the provisions of the body of this Agreement and the provisions of Annex I or Annex II, the provisions of Annex II shall prevail, followed by the provisions of Annex I, and then by the provisions of the body of this Agreement.
40: 
41: **1.4** Buy/Sell Back Transactions: **Not Applicable.** The parties do not intend to enter into Buy/Sell Back Transactions under this Agreement. If the parties wish to enter into Buy/Sell Back Transactions, they shall negotiate and agree a separate annex or amendment to this Agreement addressing such Transactions.
42: 
43: **1.5** Agency Transactions: **Not Applicable.** Neither party acts as agent for any third party in connection with any Transaction entered into under this Agreement. If the parties wish to enter into Agency Transactions, they shall negotiate and agree a separate annex or amendment to this Agreement addressing such Transactions.
44: 
45: **[Paragraph 2 --- Definitions]{.underline}**
46: 
47: **2.1** Unless otherwise defined in this Agreement or the context otherwise requires, capitalised terms used in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, which definitions are hereby incorporated by reference as if set out in full herein.
48: 
49: **2.2** In addition to the definitions set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, the following additional defined terms are introduced in Annex II and, to the extent set out therein, shall apply for the purposes of this Agreement:
50: 
51: > \(a\) \"**Eligible Collateral**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(c).
52: >
53: > \(b\) \"**Eligible Sovereign Securities**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(a).
54: >
55: > \(c\) \"**Eligible Corporate Securities**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(b).
56: >
57: > \(d\) \"**Haircut**\" or \"**Haircut Percentage**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 4.
58: >
59: > \(e\) \"**Margin Threshold**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 5.
60: >
61: > \(f\) \"**Net Exposure Cap**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 6.
62: >
63: > \(g\) \"Repricing Date\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 12.
64: >
65: > \(h\) \"Cross-Default Threshold\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 10(c).
66: >
67: > \(i\) \"Act of Insolvency Grace Period\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 11(b).
68: >
69: > \(j\) \"Equivalent Securities\" has the meaning given in the 2011 ICMA GMRA; for the avoidance of doubt, securities of the same ISIN, nominal amount, and coupon shall be deemed equivalent for the purposes of substitution and return under this Agreement.
70: 
71: **2.3** In the event of any inconsistency between a definition contained in Annex II and a definition of the same term contained in the body of this Agreement, the 2011 ICMA GMRA, or the 2011 Annex I, the definition in Annex II shall prevail.
72: 
73: **2.4** \"**Base Currency**\" means United States Dollars (USD). All calculations of Transaction Exposure, Margin Deficit, Margin Excess, Net Exposure, and all other amounts required to be computed in a single currency under this Agreement shall be calculated in, or converted into, the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange prevailing at the relevant time of determination, as reasonably determined by Buyer.
74: 
75: **2.5** \"**Business Day**\" means a day (other than a Saturday or Sunday) on which commercial banks are open for general business (including dealings in foreign exchange and foreign currency deposits) in both London, England and New York, New York, United States of America. For the avoidance of doubt, any day that is a public holiday observed by the Bank of England in London or by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York shall not constitute a Business Day for the purposes of this Agreement.
76: 
77: **2.6** For the avoidance of doubt, where any term is defined in both this Paragraph 2 and in Annex II, the Annex II definition shall govern.
78: 
79: **2.7** \"**Transaction Exposure**\" shall, for the purposes of this Agreement, be calculated by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities as of the close of business on the Business Day immediately preceding the relevant date of determination, consistent with the margin call cut-off mechanics set out in Annex II, Section 7.
80: 
81: **[Paragraph 3 --- Initiation; Confirmations]{.underline}**
82: 
83: **3.1** Each Transaction shall be entered into by telephone, electronic messaging (including Bloomberg messaging, SWIFT, or electronic mail), or such other method as may be agreed between the parties from time to time. Each party shall designate one or more authorised persons who shall have authority to enter into Transactions on its behalf, and each party shall provide the other with a written list of such authorised persons, updated from time to time as necessary.
84: 
85: **3.2** Each Transaction shall be evidenced by a Confirmation in writing delivered by Buyer or Seller (as agreed between the parties for such purpose) by close of business on the Business Day following the Purchase Date. A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail, facsimile, or through an electronic trade confirmation platform used by both parties. Each party shall use reasonable efforts to respond promptly to any Confirmation received and to notify the other party of any discrepancy in the terms set out therein.
86: 
87: **3.3** The Confirmation for each Transaction shall specify, at a minimum, the following:
88: 
89: > \(a\) the Purchase Date;
90: >
91: > \(b\) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is an open Transaction or an \"on demand\" Transaction, a statement to that effect;
92: >
93: > \(c\) the Purchased Securities, including the International Securities Identification Number (ISIN), the nominal amount or face value, and a description (including issuer name, coupon rate, and maturity date) of such securities;
94: >
95: > \(d\) the Purchase Price;
96: >
97: > \(e\) the Repurchase Price or, alternatively, the Pricing Rate and the basis for computation of the Repurchase Price;
98: >
99: > \(f\) Buyer\'s account details for the receipt of Purchased Securities and for the payment of the Purchase Price;
100: >
101: > \(g\) Seller\'s account details for the delivery of Purchased Securities and for the receipt of the Purchase Price;
102: >
103: > \(h\) the applicable Haircut Percentage;
104: >
105: > \(i\) any additional terms specifically agreed between the parties for that Transaction, including any special conditions, additional collateral requirements, or modifications to the standard terms of this Agreement applicable solely to that Transaction.
106: 
107: **3.4** A Confirmation shall, upon delivery, supplement, form part of, and be subject to this Agreement. Together with this Agreement, each Confirmation shall evidence a complete and binding agreement between the parties with respect to the Transaction to which it relates. In the event of any inconsistency between the terms of a Confirmation and the terms of this Agreement (including Annex I and Annex II), the terms of the Confirmation shall prevail with respect to the Transaction to which such Confirmation relates, unless the Confirmation expressly provides otherwise.
108: 
109: **3.5** The failure by either party to deliver a Confirmation with respect to a Transaction shall not affect the validity or enforceability of that Transaction, provided that the terms thereof have been agreed between the parties. Where a Confirmation is not delivered by the deadline specified in Paragraph 3.2, the Transaction shall nonetheless be valid and governed by this Agreement, and either party may require the other to deliver a Confirmation at any time thereafter.
110: 
111: **3.6** A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail (including as a PDF attachment), and a Confirmation so delivered shall have the same force and effect as a signed original.
112: 
113: **[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**
114: 
115: **Paragraph 4(a) --- Margin Deficit / Margin Excess**
116: 
117: **4.1** The parties shall, on each Business Day (or at such other intervals as may be agreed), mark to market all outstanding Transactions by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities and the Transaction Exposure in respect of each Transaction, each calculated in the Base Currency.
118: 
119: **4.2** If at any time the aggregate Cash Margin (if any) held by or on behalf of Buyer, together with the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), is less than the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Deficit**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Deficit shall be equal to the shortfall, calculated in the Base Currency.
120: 
121: **4.3** If at any time the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), together with any Cash Margin held by or on behalf of Buyer, exceeds the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Excess**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Excess shall be equal to the surplus, calculated in the Base Currency.
122: 
123: **Paragraph 4(b) --- Delivery Amount / Return Amount**
124: 
125: 4.4 Upon the existence of a Margin Deficit, Buyer may by notice to Seller (a \"Margin Call\") require Seller to transfer to Buyer Additional Purchased Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) in an amount sufficient to eliminate such Margin Deficit (the aggregate amount so required, the \"Delivery Amount\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Delivery Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(a) (being \$500,000 as of the date hereof).
126: 
127: 4.5 Upon the existence of a Margin Excess, Seller may by notice to Buyer (also a \"Margin Call\") require Buyer to transfer to Seller Equivalent Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) sufficient to eliminate such Margin Excess (the aggregate amount so required, the \"Return Amount\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Return Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(b) (being \$250,000 as of the date hereof).
128: 
129: **4.6** Any Additional Purchased Securities transferred by Seller to Buyer pursuant to a Margin Call must constitute Eligible Collateral, and the Market Value of such Additional Purchased Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) shall be at least equal to the Delivery Amount.
130: 
131: **Paragraph 4(c) --- Margin Call Timing**
132: 
133: **4.7** A Margin Call must be received by the other party by the margin call cut-off time specified in Annex II, Section 7 (being 10:00 a.m. London time as of the date hereof) in order for the resulting transfer to be required on that same Business Day.
134: 
135: **4.8** If a Margin Call is received before the cut-off time on a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on that same Business Day.
136: 
137: **4.9** If a Margin Call is received at or after the cut-off time on a Business Day, or on a day that is not a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on the next following Business Day.
138: 
139: **4.10** For the purposes of this Paragraph 4(c), a Margin Call shall be deemed to have been \"received\" when it is actually received by the recipient at the address, facsimile number, or electronic mail address specified in Annex II, Section 14 for the giving of notices. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to acknowledge receipt of a Margin Call promptly upon receipt.
140: 
141: **Paragraph 4(d) --- Haircuts**
142: 
143: **4.11** The applicable Haircut Percentage for each category of Eligible Collateral is as specified in Annex II, Section 4, and is summarised as follows:
144: 
145:   -----------------------------------------------------------------------
146:   **Category**                        **Haircut Percentage**
147:   ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
148:   Eligible Sovereign Securities       1.5% (the \"Sovereign Haircut\")
149: 
150:   Eligible Corporate Securities       3.5% (the \"Corporate Haircut\")
151:   -----------------------------------------------------------------------
152: 
153: **4.12** The Transaction Exposure in respect of any Transaction shall be calculated by applying the relevant Haircut Percentage to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities. The Haircut Percentage shall be applied in the manner set out in Annex II, Section 4, such that the Purchase Price for a Transaction shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of the Purchased Securities by one (1) plus the applicable Haircut Percentage (expressed as a decimal).
154: 
155: **4.13** Buyer reserves the right, upon not less than five (5) Business Days\' prior written notice to Seller, to revise the applicable Haircut Percentage for any category of Eligible Collateral in connection with future Transactions, provided that (a) any such revision shall apply only to Transactions entered into after the effective date of such revision and shall not affect the terms of any Transaction already outstanding, and (b) any such revision shall be made in good faith and on a commercially reasonable basis, having regard to prevailing market conditions, the credit quality of the relevant class of securities, and Buyer\'s internal risk management policies.
156: 
157: **[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**
158: 
159: **5.1** Where Purchased Securities are held by Buyer on a record date, ex-dividend date, or other relevant date for any distribution of Income (including, without limitation, any coupon, interest payment, dividend, principal repayment (other than at maturity), or other distribution payable in respect of such Purchased Securities), Buyer shall, on the next Business Day following the date on which Buyer receives or is credited with such Income, pay to Seller an amount equal to such Income (a \"**Manufactured Payment**\").
160: 
161: **5.2** Manufactured Payments shall be made in the currency in which the relevant Income payment is denominated and shall be paid to the account designated by Seller for the receipt of funds in such currency, as specified in the relevant Confirmation or as otherwise notified by Seller to Buyer in writing.
162: 
163: **5.3** All Manufactured Payments shall be made net of any applicable withholding tax, deduction, or other amount required to be withheld or deducted by Buyer under applicable law. If Buyer is required by applicable law to make any such withholding or deduction, the provisions of Paragraph 11 (Tax) shall apply with respect to any obligation of Buyer to gross up such payment.
164: 
165: **5.4** For the avoidance of doubt, the obligation to make a Manufactured Payment arises regardless of whether Buyer has actually received the relevant Income payment from the issuer of the Purchased Securities. Buyer\'s obligation to make the Manufactured Payment is an independent obligation under this Agreement and shall not be conditional upon Buyer\'s receipt of the underlying Income.
166: 
167: **5.5** In respect of any partial coupon period, the Manufactured Payment shall be calculated on an actual/actual (ICMA) day-count basis for Eligible Sovereign Securities and a 30/360 basis for Eligible Corporate Securities, unless otherwise specified in the relevant Confirmation.
168: 
169: **[Paragraph 6 --- Payment and Transfer]{.underline}**
170: 
171: **Paragraph 6(a) --- Method**
172: 
173: **6.1** All payments of cash required to be made under this Agreement shall be made in immediately available, freely transferable, same-day funds in the relevant currency to the account specified by the receiving party in the relevant Confirmation, in Annex II, Section 14, or as otherwise notified by the receiving party to the paying party in writing from time to time.
174: 
175: **6.2** All transfers of Securities required to be made under this Agreement (including the initial transfer of Purchased Securities, the transfer of Additional Purchased Securities, the return of Equivalent Securities, and the transfer of Alternative Securities upon substitution) shall be made through the applicable settlement system, as follows:
176: 
177: > \(a\) For Euro-denominated Eligible Collateral: **Clearstream Banking S.A.**, in accordance with the rules and procedures of Clearstream Banking S.A. as in effect from time to time.
178: >
179: > \(b\) For USD-denominated Eligible Collateral: **The Depository Trust Company (DTC)**, in accordance with the rules and procedures of DTC as in effect from time to time.
180: 
181: **6.3** Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses in connection with the settlement of Securities through the applicable settlement system, including any fees or charges imposed by the settlement system operator, the relevant custodian, or any intermediary in the settlement chain, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the parties.
182: 
183: **6.4** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties for a specific Transaction, all deliveries of Securities shall be made on a delivery-versus-payment (DvP) basis. If DvP settlement is not available or practicable for a particular Transaction, the parties shall agree in advance on an alternative delivery mechanism and shall cooperate in good faith to minimise settlement risk.
184: 
185: **Paragraph 6(b) --- Netting**
186: 
187: **6.5** As elected in Annex II, Section 8, Paragraph 7(b) of this Agreement (settlement netting for obligations in the same currency falling due on the same settlement date) shall apply. The parties agree that, where on any Business Day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and on the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether under Paragraph 4, Paragraph 5, or otherwise under this Agreement), such obligations shall be subject to the netting provisions set out in Paragraph 7 below.
188: 
189: **[Paragraph 7 --- Netting of Obligations]{.underline}**
190: 
191: **Paragraph 7(a) --- Payment Netting**
192: 
193: **7.1** The standard payment netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. Accordingly, where on any Business Day amounts would be payable by each party to the other in the same currency and on the same value date, the mutual obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount. Such single net payment shall be made by the party owing the net amount on the relevant value date in the manner specified in Paragraph 6(a).
194: 
195: **Paragraph 7(b) --- Close-out Netting / Settlement Netting**
196: 
197: **7.2** **Elected.** If on any day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and in respect of the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether pursuant to Paragraph 4 (Margin Maintenance), Paragraph 5 (Income Payments), Paragraph 10 (Events of Default), or otherwise under this Agreement), the obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and, if the aggregate amount payable by one party exceeds the aggregate amount payable by the other party, replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount.
198: 
199: **7.3** The single net amount determined in accordance with Paragraph 7.2 above shall be payable in the relevant currency on the relevant settlement date, and only the net amount shall be required to be paid by the party owing such amount. The other party shall have no obligation to make any payment in respect of the amounts so netted.
200: 
201: **7.4** Each party represents that the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7 are enforceable against it in all relevant jurisdictions, including the jurisdiction of its incorporation or organisation, the jurisdiction of its principal office, and any other jurisdiction in which it conducts business or holds assets. Each party agrees to take such steps and execute such documents as may reasonably be required to give effect to the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7.
202: 
203: **[Paragraph 8 --- Substitution]{.underline}**
204: 
205: 8.1 Subject to the provisions of Annex II, Section 9, Seller may from time to time during the term of any Transaction effect a substitution of Alternative Securities for all or any part of the Purchased Securities in that Transaction.
206: 
207: 8.2 Any notice of substitution shall be made by Seller to Buyer in writing (including by electronic mail) and shall specify in reasonable detail the Purchased Securities to be replaced, the proposed Alternative Securities (including ISIN, nominal amount, issuer, coupon, maturity, and credit rating), and the proposed substitution date.
208: 
209: 8.3 Seller shall give Buyer not less than one (1) Business Day\'s prior notice of any proposed substitution. No consent of Buyer shall be required. The substitution may be effected only if no Margin Deficit exists at the time of substitution and the Alternative Securities are of the same or better Eligible Collateral category as the Purchased Securities being replaced.
210: 
211: 8.4 The substitution shall be effected on the Business Day specified in Seller\'s notice by simultaneous transfer of the Alternative Securities to Buyer and the relevant Purchased Securities to Seller, in each case in accordance with Paragraph 6.
212: 
213: 8.5 Any Alternative Securities transferred by Seller must qualify as Eligible Collateral and must satisfy all of the eligibility criteria set out in Annex II, Section 3. The Market Value of the Alternative Securities after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage must be at least equal to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities being replaced after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage.
214: 
215: 8.6 Upon completion of a substitution, the Alternative Securities shall become the Purchased Securities for all purposes of the relevant Transaction, and the Confirmation for such Transaction shall be deemed to have been amended accordingly.
216: 
217: **[Paragraph 9 --- Representations]{.underline}**
218: 
219: **9.1** Each party represents and warrants to the other, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date on which it enters into a Transaction, that:
220: 
221: > \(a\) **Due Organisation and Authority.** It is duly organised, validly existing, and in good standing (or the equivalent) under the laws of its jurisdiction of incorporation or organisation. It has the full power and authority to execute, deliver, and perform its obligations under this Agreement and each Transaction, and has taken all necessary corporate, regulatory, or other action to authorise such execution, delivery, and performance.
222: >
223: > \(b\) **No Violation.** The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction do not and will not (i) violate or conflict with any provision of its constitutional or organisational documents (including, without limitation, its memorandum and articles of association, certificate of formation, limited liability company agreement, partnership agreement, or equivalent documents), (ii) violate or conflict with any applicable law, rule, regulation, order, judgment, or decree of any governmental authority or regulatory body having jurisdiction over it, or (iii) result in a breach of, or constitute a default under, any agreement, instrument, or obligation to which it is a party or by which it or any of its assets may be bound.
224: >
225: > \(c\) **Governmental and Regulatory Approvals.** All governmental and regulatory consents, approvals, authorisations, registrations, filings, and notices that are necessary for the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction have been obtained or made and are in full force and effect.
226: >
227: > \(d\) **Binding Obligations.** This Agreement and each Transaction constitute legal, valid, and binding obligations of such party, enforceable against it in accordance with their respective terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganisation, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to equitable principles of general applicability.
228: >
229: > \(e\) **No Litigation.** There is no pending or, to the best of its knowledge, threatened action, suit, proceeding, inquiry, or investigation before or by any court, tribunal, governmental authority, or regulatory body which would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement or any Transaction, or which questions the validity or enforceability of this Agreement or any Transaction.
230: >
231: > \(f\) **Accuracy of Information.** All information furnished by it to the other party in connection with this Agreement and each Transaction is true, accurate, and complete in all material respects as of the date on which such information is furnished, and it is not aware of any fact or circumstance that has not been disclosed to the other party and that might reasonably be expected to materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement or any Transaction.
232: >
233: > \(g\) **Internal Approvals.** It has obtained all internal credit committee and risk committee approvals necessary for the execution of this Agreement and for entry into Transactions hereunder.
234: 
235: **9.2** **Additional Seller Representation.** Meridian Capital Securities LLC represents and warrants, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date, that it is duly registered as a broker-dealer with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under Section 15 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and is a member in good standing of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), CRD# 298417. Seller further represents that its registration and membership are in full force and effect, that it is not subject to any suspension, revocation, or restriction on its registration or membership that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and that it is in compliance in all material respects with all applicable requirements of the SEC and FINRA. Seller further represents that it is in compliance in all material respects with the net capital requirements of Rule 15c3-1 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and covenants that it shall promptly notify Buyer in writing if its net capital falls below 120% of the minimum amount required under Rule 15c3-1.
236: 
237: **9.3** **Additional Buyer Representation.** Voss Bank AG represents and warrants, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date, that it is duly authorised and regulated as a bank by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) with its registered head office at Talstrasse 62, 8001 Zürich, Switzerland, and that its London Branch is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and subject to regulation by the Financial Conduct Authority and limited regulation by the Prudential Regulation Authority, FCA Firm Reference Number 487203. Buyer further represents that all such authorisations are in full force and effect, that it is not subject to any suspension, revocation, or restriction on any such authorisation that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and that it is in compliance in all material respects with all applicable requirements of FINMA, the PRA, and the FCA. Buyer further represents that it maintains Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital in excess of the minimum requirements prescribed by FINMA and the PRA for its London Branch operations.
238: 
239: **[Paragraph 10 --- Events of Default]{.underline}**
240: 
241: **Paragraph 10(a) --- Standard Events of Default**
242: 
243: **10.1** Each of the following shall constitute an \"**Event of Default**\" with respect to a party (the \"**Defaulting Party**\"):
244: 
245: > \(i\) **Failure to Pay or Deliver.** Such party fails to pay any amount or deliver any Securities when due under this Agreement or any Transaction (including, without limitation, any Purchase Price, Repurchase Price, Cash Margin, Manufactured Payment, or margin transfer), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party. For the avoidance of doubt, \"failure to pay\" includes a failure to make a Manufactured Payment under Paragraph 5. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a failure caused solely by an administrative or operational error in a settlement system shall not constitute an Event of Default under this sub-paragraph (i) if such failure is cured within two (2) Business Days of the paying party becoming aware of such failure.
246: >
247: > \(ii\) **Failure to Comply with Margin Call.** Such party fails to comply with a Margin Call made in accordance with Paragraph 4 (including any failure to transfer Additional Purchased Securities, Equivalent Securities, or Cash Margin in the amount and by the time required), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party.
248: >
249: > \(iii\) **Breach of Representation.** Any representation or warranty made or deemed repeated by such party under Paragraph 9 (or elsewhere in this Agreement) is materially incorrect or misleading when made or when deemed repeated.

If the parties wish to enter into Buy/Sell Back Transactions, they shall negotiate and agree a separate annex or amendment to this Agreement addressing such Transactions.

**1.5** Agency Transactions: **Not Applicable.** Neither party acts as agent for any third party in connection with any Transaction entered into under this Agreement. If the parties wish to enter into Agency Transactions, they shall negotiate and agree a separate annex or amendment to this Agreement addressing such Transactions.
**[Paragraph 2 --- Definitions]{.underline}**

**2.1** Unless otherwise defined in this Agreement or the context otherwise requires, capitalised terms used in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, which definitions are hereby incorporated by reference as if set out in full herein.

**2.2** In addition to the definitions set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, the following additional defined terms are introduced in Annex II and, to the extent set out therein, shall apply for the purposes of this Agreement:
> \(a\) \"**Eligible Collateral**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(c).
> \(b\) \"**Eligible Sovereign Securities**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(a).
> \(c\) \"**Eligible Corporate Securities**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(b).
> \(d\) \"**Haircut**\" or \"**Haircut Percentage**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 4.
> \(e\) \"**Margin Threshold**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 5.
> \(f\) \"**Net Exposure Cap**\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 6.
> \(g\) \"Repricing Date\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 12.
> \(h\) \"Cross-Default Threshold\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 10(c).
> \(i\) \"Act of Insolvency Grace Period\" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 11(b).

> \(j\) \"Equivalent Securities\" has the meaning given in the 2011 ICMA GMRA; for the avoidance of doubt, securities of the same ISIN, nominal amount, and coupon shall be deemed equivalent for the purposes of substitution and return under this Agreement.

**2.3** In the event of any inconsistency between a definition contained in Annex II and a definition of the same term contained in the body of this Agreement, the 2011 ICMA GMRA, or the 2011 Annex I, the definition in Annex II shall prevail.

**2.4** \"**Base Currency**\" means United States Dollars (USD). All calculations of Transaction Exposure, Margin Deficit, Margin Excess, Net Exposure, and all other amounts required to be computed in a single currency under this Agreement shall be calculated in, or converted into, the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange prevailing at the relevant time of determination, as reasonably determined by Buyer.

**2.5** \"**Business Day**\" means a day (other than a Saturday or Sunday) on which commercial banks are open for general business (including dealings in foreign exchange and foreign currency deposits) in both London, England and New York, New York, United States of America. For the avoidance of doubt, any day that is a public holiday observed by the Bank of England in London or by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York shall not constitute a Business Day for the purposes of this Agreement.
**2.6** For the avoidance of doubt, where any term is defined in both this Paragraph 2 and in Annex II, the Annex II definition shall govern.

**2.7** \"**Transaction Exposure**\" shall, for the purposes of this Agreement, be calculated by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities as of the close of business on the Business Day immediately preceding the relevant date of determination, consistent with the margin call cut-off mechanics set out in Annex II, Section 7.
**[Paragraph 3 --- Initiation; Confirmations]{.underline}**

**3.1** Each Transaction shall be entered into by telephone, electronic messaging (including Bloomberg messaging, SWIFT, or electronic mail), or such other method as may be agreed between the parties from time to time. Each party shall designate one or more authorised persons who shall have authority to enter into Transactions on its behalf, and each party shall provide the other with a written list of such authorised persons, updated from time to time as necessary.

**3.2** Each Transaction shall be evidenced by a Confirmation in writing delivered by Buyer or Seller (as agreed between the parties for such purpose) by close of business on the Business Day following the Purchase Date. A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail, facsimile, or through an electronic trade confirmation platform used by both parties. Each party shall use reasonable efforts to respond promptly to any Confirmation received and to notify the other party of any discrepancy in the terms set out therein.
**3.3** The Confirmation for each Transaction shall specify, at a minimum, the following:
> \(a\) the Purchase Date;
> \(b\) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is an open Transaction or an \"on demand\" Transaction, a statement to that effect;

> \(c\) the Purchased Securities, including the International Securities Identification Number (ISIN), the nominal amount or face value, and a description (including issuer name, coupon rate, and maturity date) of such securities;
> \(d\) the Purchase Price;
> \(e\) the Repurchase Price or, alternatively, the Pricing Rate and the basis for computation of the Repurchase Price;
> \(f\) Buyer\'s account details for the receipt of Purchased Securities and for the payment of the Purchase Price;
> \(g\) Seller\'s account details for the delivery of Purchased Securities and for the receipt of the Purchase Price;
> \(h\) the applicable Haircut Percentage;

> \(i\) any additional terms specifically agreed between the parties for that Transaction, including any special conditions, additional collateral requirements, or modifications to the standard terms of this Agreement applicable solely to that Transaction.

**3.4** A Confirmation shall, upon delivery, supplement, form part of, and be subject to this Agreement. Together with this Agreement, each Confirmation shall evidence a complete and binding agreement between the parties with respect to the Transaction to which it relates. In the event of any inconsistency between the terms of a Confirmation and the terms of this Agreement (including Annex I and Annex II), the terms of the Confirmation shall prevail with respect to the Transaction to which such Confirmation relates, unless the Confirmation expressly provides otherwise.

**3.5** The failure by either party to deliver a Confirmation with respect to a Transaction shall not affect the validity or enforceability of that Transaction, provided that the terms thereof have been agreed between the parties. Where a Confirmation is not delivered by the deadline specified in Paragraph 3.2, the Transaction shall nonetheless be valid and governed by this Agreement, and either party may require the other to deliver a Confirmation at any time thereafter.
**3.6** A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail (including as a PDF attachment), and a Confirmation so delivered shall have the same force and effect as a signed original.
**[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**
**Paragraph 4(a) --- Margin Deficit / Margin Excess**

**4.1** The parties shall, on each Business Day (or at such other intervals as may be agreed), mark to market all outstanding Transactions by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities and the Transaction Exposure in respect of each Transaction, each calculated in the Base Currency.

**4.2** If at any time the aggregate Cash Margin (if any) held by or on behalf of Buyer, together with the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), is less than the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Deficit**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Deficit shall be equal to the shortfall, calculated in the Base Currency.

**4.3** If at any time the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), together with any Cash Margin held by or on behalf of Buyer, exceeds the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Excess**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Excess shall be equal to the surplus, calculated in the Base Currency.
**Paragraph 4(b) --- Delivery Amount / Return Amount**

4.4 Upon the existence of a Margin Deficit, Buyer may by notice to Seller (a \"Margin Call\") require Seller to transfer to Buyer Additional Purchased Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) in an amount sufficient to eliminate such Margin Deficit (the aggregate amount so required, the \"Delivery Amount\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Delivery Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(a) (being \$500,000 as of the date hereof).

4.5 Upon the existence of a Margin Excess, Seller may by notice to Buyer (also a \"Margin Call\") require Buyer to transfer to Seller Equivalent Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) sufficient to eliminate such Margin Excess (the aggregate amount so required, the \"Return Amount\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Return Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(b) (being \$250,000 as of the date hereof).

**4.6** Any Additional Purchased Securities transferred by Seller to Buyer pursuant to a Margin Call must constitute Eligible Collateral, and the Market Value of such Additional Purchased Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) shall be at least equal to the Delivery Amount.
**Paragraph 4(c) --- Margin Call Timing**

**4.7** A Margin Call must be received by the other party by the margin call cut-off time specified in Annex II, Section 7 (being 10:00 a.m. London time as of the date hereof) in order for the resulting transfer to be required on that same Business Day.
**4.8** If a Margin Call is received before the cut-off time on a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on that same Business Day.

**4.9** If a Margin Call is received at or after the cut-off time on a Business Day, or on a day that is not a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on the next following Business Day.

**4.10** For the purposes of this Paragraph 4(c), a Margin Call shall be deemed to have been \"received\" when it is actually received by the recipient at the address, facsimile number, or electronic mail address specified in Annex II, Section 14 for the giving of notices. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to acknowledge receipt of a Margin Call promptly upon receipt.
**Paragraph 4(d) --- Haircuts**
**4.11** The applicable Haircut Percentage for each category of Eligible Collateral is as specified in Annex II, Section 4, and is summarised as follows:
**Category**                        **Haircut Percentage**
Eligible Sovereign Securities       1.5% (the \"Sovereign Haircut\")
Eligible Corporate Securities       3.5% (the \"Corporate Haircut\")

**4.12** The Transaction Exposure in respect of any Transaction shall be calculated by applying the relevant Haircut Percentage to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities. The Haircut Percentage shall be applied in the manner set out in Annex II, Section 4, such that the Purchase Price for a Transaction shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of the Purchased Securities by one (1) plus the applicable Haircut Percentage (expressed as a decimal).

**4.13** Buyer reserves the right, upon not less than five (5) Business Days\' prior written notice to Seller, to revise the applicable Haircut Percentage for any category of Eligible Collateral in connection with future Transactions, provided that (a) any such revision shall apply only to Transactions entered into after the effective date of such revision and shall not affect the terms of any Transaction already outstanding, and (b) any such revision shall be made in good faith and on a commercially reasonable basis, having regard to prevailing market conditions, the credit quality of the relevant class of securities, and Buyer\'s internal risk management policies.
**[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**

**5.1** Where Purchased Securities are held by Buyer on a record date, ex-dividend date, or other relevant date for any distribution of Income (including, without limitation, any coupon, interest payment, dividend, principal repayment (other than at maturity), or other distribution payable in respect of such Purchased Securities), Buyer shall, on the next Business Day following the date on which Buyer receives or is credited with such Income, pay to Seller an amount equal to such Income (a \"**Manufactured Payment**\").

**5.2** Manufactured Payments shall be made in the currency in which the relevant Income payment is denominated and shall be paid to the account designated by Seller for the receipt of funds in such currency, as specified in the relevant Confirmation or as otherwise notified by Seller to Buyer in writing.

**5.3** All Manufactured Payments shall be made net of any applicable withholding tax, deduction, or other amount required to be withheld or deducted by Buyer under applicable law. If Buyer is required by applicable law to make any such withholding or deduction, the provisions of Paragraph 11 (Tax) shall apply with respect to any obligation of Buyer to gross up such payment.

**5.4** For the avoidance of doubt, the obligation to make a Manufactured Payment arises regardless of whether Buyer has actually received the relevant Income payment from the issuer of the Purchased Securities. Buyer\'s obligation to make the Manufactured Payment is an independent obligation under this Agreement and shall not be conditional upon Buyer\'s receipt of the underlying Income.

**5.5** In respect of any partial coupon period, the Manufactured Payment shall be calculated on an actual/actual (ICMA) day-count basis for Eligible Sovereign Securities and a 30/360 basis for Eligible Corporate Securities, unless otherwise specified in the relevant Confirmation.
**[Paragraph 6 --- Payment and Transfer]{.underline}**
**Paragraph 6(a) --- Method**

**6.1** All payments of cash required to be made under this Agreement shall be made in immediately available, freely transferable, same-day funds in the relevant currency to the account specified by the receiving party in the relevant Confirmation, in Annex II, Section 14, or as otherwise notified by the receiving party to the paying party in writing from time to time.

**6.2** All transfers of Securities required to be made under this Agreement (including the initial transfer of Purchased Securities, the transfer of Additional Purchased Securities, the return of Equivalent Securities, and the transfer of Alternative Securities upon substitution) shall be made through the applicable settlement system, as follows:
> \(a\) For Euro-denominated Eligible Collateral: **Clearstream Banking S.A.**, in accordance with the rules and procedures of Clearstream Banking S.A. as in effect from time to time.
> \(b\) For USD-denominated Eligible Collateral: **The Depository Trust Company (DTC)**, in accordance with the rules and procedures of DTC as in effect from time to time.

**6.3** Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses in connection with the settlement of Securities through the applicable settlement system, including any fees or charges imposed by the settlement system operator, the relevant custodian, or any intermediary in the settlement chain, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the parties.

**6.4** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties for a specific Transaction, all deliveries of Securities shall be made on a delivery-versus-payment (DvP) basis. If DvP settlement is not available or practicable for a particular Transaction, the parties shall agree in advance on an alternative delivery mechanism and shall cooperate in good faith to minimise settlement risk.
**Paragraph 6(b) --- Netting**

**6.5** As elected in Annex II, Section 8, Paragraph 7(b) of this Agreement (settlement netting for obligations in the same currency falling due on the same settlement date) shall apply. The parties agree that, where on any Business Day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and on the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether under Paragraph 4, Paragraph 5, or otherwise under this Agreement), such obligations shall be subject to the netting provisions set out in Paragraph 7 below.
**[Paragraph 7 --- Netting of Obligations]{.underline}**
**Paragraph 7(a) --- Payment Netting**

**7.1** The standard payment netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. Accordingly, where on any Business Day amounts would be payable by each party to the other in the same currency and on the same value date, the mutual obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount. Such single net payment shall be made by the party owing the net amount on the relevant value date in the manner specified in Paragraph 6(a).
**Paragraph 7(b) --- Close-out Netting / Settlement Netting**

**7.2** **Elected.** If on any day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and in respect of the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether pursuant to Paragraph 4 (Margin Maintenance), Paragraph 5 (Income Payments), Paragraph 10 (Events of Default), or otherwise under this Agreement), the obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and, if the aggregate amount payable by one party exceeds the aggregate amount payable by the other party, replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount.

**7.3** The single net amount determined in accordance with Paragraph 7.2 above shall be payable in the relevant currency on the relevant settlement date, and only the net amount shall be required to be paid by the party owing such amount. The other party shall have no obligation to make any payment in respect of the amounts so netted.

**7.4** Each party represents that the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7 are enforceable against it in all relevant jurisdictions, including the jurisdiction of its incorporation or organisation, the jurisdiction of its principal office, and any other jurisdiction in which it conducts business or holds assets. Each party agrees to take such steps and execute such documents as may reasonably be required to give effect to the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7.
**[Paragraph 8 --- Substitution]{.underline}**

8.1 Subject to the provisions of Annex II, Section 9, Seller may from time to time during the term of any Transaction effect a substitution of Alternative Securities for all or any part of the Purchased Securities in that Transaction.

8.2 Any notice of substitution shall be made by Seller to Buyer in writing (including by electronic mail) and shall specify in reasonable detail the Purchased Securities to be replaced, the proposed Alternative Securities (including ISIN, nominal amount, issuer, coupon, maturity, and credit rating), and the proposed substitution date.

8.3 Seller shall give Buyer not less than one (1) Business Day\'s prior notice of any proposed substitution. No consent of Buyer shall be required. The substitution may be effected only if no Margin Deficit exists at the time of substitution and the Alternative Securities are of the same or better Eligible Collateral category as the Purchased Securities being replaced.

8.4 The substitution shall be effected on the Business Day specified in Seller\'s notice by simultaneous transfer of the Alternative Securities to Buyer and the relevant Purchased Securities to Seller, in each case in accordance with Paragraph 6.

8.5 Any Alternative Securities transferred by Seller must qualify as Eligible Collateral and must satisfy all of the eligibility criteria set out in Annex II, Section 3. The Market Value of the Alternative Securities after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage must be at least equal to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities being replaced after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage.

8.6 Upon completion of a substitution, the Alternative Securities shall become the Purchased Securities for all purposes of the relevant Transaction, and the Confirmation for such Transaction shall be deemed to have been amended accordingly.
**[Paragraph 9 --- Representations]{.underline}**
**9.1** Each party represents and warrants to the other, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date on which it enters into a Transaction, that:

> \(a\) **Due Organisation and Authority.** It is duly organised, validly existing, and in good standing (or the equivalent) under the laws of its jurisdiction of incorporation or organisation. It has the full power and authority to execute, deliver, and perform its obligations under this Agreement and each Transaction, and has taken all necessary corporate, regulatory, or other action to authorise such execution, delivery, and performance.

> \(b\) **No Violation.** The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction do not and will not (i) violate or conflict with any provision of its constitutional or organisational documents (including, without limitation, its memorandum and articles of association, certificate of formation, limited liability company agreement, partnership agreement, or equivalent documents), (ii) violate or conflict with any applicable law, rule, regulation, order, judgment, or decree of any governmental authority or regulatory body having jurisdiction over it, or (iii) result in a breach of, or constitute a default under, any agreement, instrument, or obligation to which it is a party or by which it or any of its assets may be bound.

> \(c\) **Governmental and Regulatory Approvals.** All governmental and regulatory consents, approvals, authorisations, registrations, filings, and notices that are necessary for the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction have been obtained or made and are in full force and effect.

> \(d\) **Binding Obligations.** This Agreement and each Transaction constitute legal, valid, and binding obligations of such party, enforceable against it in accordance with their respective terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganisation, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to equitable principles of general applicability.

> \(e\) **No Litigation.** There is no pending or, to the best of its knowledge, threatened action, suit, proceeding, inquiry, or investigation before or by any court, tribunal, governmental authority, or regulatory body which would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement or any Transaction, or which questions the validity or enforceability of this Agreement or any Transaction.

> \(f\) **Accuracy of Information.** All information furnished by it to the other party in connection with this Agreement and each Transaction is true, accurate, and complete in all material respects as of the date on which such information is furnished, and it is not aware of any fact or circumstance that has not been disclosed to the other party and that might reasonably be expected to materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement or any Transaction.
> \(g\) **Internal Approvals.** It has obtained all internal credit committee and risk committee approvals necessary for the execution of this Agreement and for entry into Transactions hereunder.

**9.2** **Additional Seller Representation.** Meridian Capital Securities LLC represents and warrants, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date, that it is duly registered as a broker-dealer with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under Section 15 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and is a member in good standing of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), CRD# 298417. Seller further represents that its registration and membership are in full force and effect, that it is not subject to any suspension, revocation, or restriction on its registration or membership that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and that it is in compliance in all material respects with all applicable requirements of the SEC and FINRA. Seller further represents that it is in compliance in all material respects with the net capital requirements of Rule 15c3-1 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and covenants that it shall promptly notify Buyer in writing if its net capital falls below 120% of the minimum amount required under Rule 15c3-1.

**9.3** **Additional Buyer Representation.** Voss Bank AG represents and warrants, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date, that it is duly authorised and regulated as a bank by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) with its registered head office at Talstrasse 62, 8001 Zürich, Switzerland, and that its London Branch is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and subject to regulation by the Financial Conduct Authority and limited regulation by the Prudential Regulation Authority, FCA Firm Reference Number 487203. Buyer further represents that all such authorisations are in full force and effect, that it is not subject to any suspension, revocation, or restriction on any such authorisation that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and that it is in compliance in all material respects with all applicable requirements of FINMA, the PRA, and the FCA. Buyer further represents that it maintains Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital in excess of the minimum requirements prescribed by FINMA and the PRA for its London Branch operations.
**[Paragraph 10 --- Events of Default]{.underline}**
**Paragraph 10(a) --- Standard Events of Default**
**10.1** Each of the following shall constitute an \"**Event of Default**\" with respect to a party (the \"**Defaulting Party**\"):

> \(i\) **Failure to Pay or Deliver.** Such party fails to pay any amount or deliver any Securities when due under this Agreement or any Transaction (including, without limitation, any Purchase Price, Repurchase Price, Cash Margin, Manufactured Payment, or margin transfer), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party. For the avoidance of doubt, \"failure to pay\" includes a failure to make a Manufactured Payment under Paragraph 5. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a failure caused solely by an administrative or operational error in a settlement system shall not constitute an Event of Default under this sub-paragraph (i) if such failure is cured within two (2) Business Days of the paying party becoming aware of such failure.

> \(ii\) **Failure to Comply with Margin Call.** Such party fails to comply with a Margin Call made in accordance with Paragraph 4 (including any failure to transfer Additional Purchased Securities, Equivalent Securities, or Cash Margin in the amount and by the time required), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party.

> \(iii\) **Breach of Representation.** Any representation or warranty made or deemed repeated by such party under Paragraph 9 (or elsewhere in this Agreement) is materially incorrect or misleading when made or when deemed repeated.

Each party shall be responsible for its own tax obligations arising in connection with this Agreement and any Transaction, and each party shall provide to the other party such tax forms, certificates, and other documentation as the other party may reasonably request in order to establish any available exemption from, or reduction in the rate of, any withholding or deduction for or on account of tax.

**11.2** Each party represents that it has provided, or will provide promptly upon request, accurate and complete information regarding its tax status, residency, and any applicable tax identification numbers to the other party, and will promptly notify the other party of any change in such information. **Paragraph 11(b) --- Tax Gross-Up**

**11.3** **Elected.** If either party (the \"**Tax Payor**\") is required by any applicable law, regulation, or governmental or regulatory authority to make any deduction or withholding from any payment due under this Agreement (including, without limitation, any Manufactured Payment, any payment of the Purchase Price or the Repurchase Price, any payment of Cash Margin, or any payment of a close-out amount), the Tax Payor shall pay such additional amounts (the \"**Tax Gross-Up Amounts**\") as may be necessary to ensure that the other party (the \"**Tax Payee**\") receives the full amount that it would have received had no such deduction or withholding been required.

**11.4** The Tax Payor\'s obligation to pay Tax Gross-Up Amounts shall not apply to the extent that the deduction or withholding arises as a result of (a) the Tax Payee\'s failure to provide any tax form, certificate, or other documentation reasonably requested by the Tax Payor, (b) the Tax Payee\'s failure to comply with any applicable procedural requirement for claiming an exemption from or reduction in the rate of withholding, or (c) a change in tax residency of the Tax Payee after the date of this Agreement.

**11.5** **Cure Period.** If a Tax Payor fails to pay any Tax Gross-Up Amount required under this Paragraph 11(b), the Tax Payee shall give written notice of such failure to the Tax Payor. The Tax Payor shall have a cure period of five (5) Business Days from receipt of such notice within which to pay the outstanding Tax Gross-Up Amount in full. Failure of the Tax Payor to cure such failure within such five (5) Business Day period shall constitute an Event of Default with respect to the Tax Payor, and the Tax Payee may thereafter exercise its rights under Paragraph 10(b) of this Agreement.
**[Paragraph 12 --- Interest]{.underline}**

**12.1** The standard interest provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. If any amount payable by a party under this Agreement is not paid on the date on which it falls due, interest shall accrue on such unpaid amount from (and including) the due date to (but excluding) the date of actual payment, at a rate per annum equal to the overnight rate for the relevant currency (as determined by the Non-Defaulting Party in a commercially reasonable manner, by reference to the rate published by the relevant central bank or an equivalent interbank overnight rate source) plus one percent (1%) per annum. For the purposes of this Paragraph 12, the \"overnight rate\" for USD shall be the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) as published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York; for GBP, the Sterling Overnight Index Average (SONIA) as published by the Bank of England; and for EUR, the Euro Short-Term Rate (€STR) as published by the European Central Bank.

**12.2** Interest accruing under this Paragraph 12 shall be calculated on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed and a 360-day year (in the case of USD and EUR) or a 365-day year (in the case of GBP), and shall be payable on demand.
**12.3** The payment of interest under this Paragraph 12 shall be without prejudice to any other rights or remedies available to the Non-Defaulting Party under this Agreement or at law.
**[Paragraph 13 --- Single Agreement]{.underline}**

> Haircut Percentage: 1.75% (the \"Sovereign Haircut\").

> Application: The Purchase Price for a Transaction in which the Purchased Securities are Eligible Sovereign Securities shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of such Purchased Securities by 1.0175.

**(a)** The definition of \"Act of Insolvency\" shall be as set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA, supplemented as follows.

**(c)** For the avoidance of doubt, and without limiting the definition of Act of Insolvency set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA, each of the following shall constitute an Act of Insolvency for the purposes of this Agreement:

import zipfile
from lxml import etree
f='output/turn-3-redline-gmra.docx'
with zipfile.ZipFile(f) as z:r=etree.fromstring(z.read('word/document.xml'));c=etree.fromstring(z.read('word/comments.xml'))
ns={'w':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
print('ins',len(r.xpath('.//w:ins',namespaces=ns)),'del',len(r.xpath('.//w:del',namespaces=ns)),'comments',len(c.xpath('.//w:comment',namespaces=ns)),'anchors',len(r.xpath('.//w:commentRangeStart',namespaces=ns)))
for pat in ['1.75%','4.25%','$500,000','$250,000','$25,000,000','Fifteen (15) Business Days','$5,000,000','Clearstream Banking S.A.','The Depository Trust Company','BNY Meliora Trust Company']:
 texts=[''.join(p.xpath('.//w:t/text()',namespaces=ns)) for p in r.xpath('.//w:body/w:p',namespaces=ns)]
 print(pat, sum(pat in s for s in texts))
print('p18 headings',sum('Paragraph 18' in ''.join(p.xpath('.//w:t/text()',namespaces=ns)) for p in r.xpath('.//w:body/w:p',namespaces=ns)))
print('sub e rows',sum(s.startswith('(e) Upon completion of a substitution') for s in texts))
PY","description":"Run final DOCX structural and numerical checks"}

**(a)** For the purposes of Paragraph 10(a)(vi) of the Agreement, a \"**Cross-Default**\" shall occur with respect to a party if:

> \(i\) such party fails to make any payment or delivery when due (after giving effect to any applicable grace period) under one or more agreements or instruments relating to Specified Indebtedness in an aggregate amount exceeding the Cross-Default Threshold; or

> \(ii\) such party\'s Specified Indebtedness in an aggregate amount exceeding the Cross-Default Threshold is accelerated, or becomes capable of being accelerated, prior to its stated maturity as a result of a default (howsoever described) thereunder; or

> \(iii\) any security interest securing Specified Indebtedness in an aggregate amount exceeding the Cross-Default Threshold becomes enforceable and is enforced (including by the taking of possession or the appointment of a receiver, administrative receiver, manager, or other similar officer).

**(c) \"Cross-Default Threshold\" means, with respect to each party, \$25,000,000 (twenty-five million United States Dollars) (or its equivalent in any other currency, converted into the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange at the relevant time).**

**(d)** For the purposes of determining whether the Cross-Default Threshold has been exceeded, all amounts of Specified Indebtedness in respect of which the relevant event has occurred shall be aggregated (regardless of whether such amounts arise under the same or different agreements or instruments).

**(b) Grace Period: Fifteen (15) Business Days. An Act of Insolvency shall not constitute an Event of Default unless it has continued unremedied for a period of fifteen (15) Business Days following the date on which the Non-Defaulting Party first becomes aware of, or receives written notice of, such Act of Insolvency (the \"Act of Insolvency Grace Period\").**
**Section 12 --- Repricing / Mini Close-out**

**(a) Buyer may, at its sole option, elect to reprice any Transaction having an original term or then-current term exceeding sixty (60) calendar days. Such repricing (a \"Repricing Event\") may be exercised on the 90th calendar day following the Purchase Date or on a quarterly anniversary of that Purchase Date, whichever is later (each a \"Repricing Date\"). If a Repricing Date falls on a day that is not a Business Day, it shall be the next following Business Day. (b) Buyer shall exercise a Repricing Event by delivering written notice to Seller not less than two (2) Business Days prior to the applicable Repricing Date. (c) Upon a Repricing Event, the original Transaction shall terminate and the parties shall simultaneously enter into a new Transaction, with the Purchase Price recalculated based on the Market Value of the Purchased Securities on the Repricing Date after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage; any close-out amount shall be settled in cash on that date. (d) This mechanic does not affect Paragraph 4 margin or Paragraph 10 default rights. (e) The new Transaction shall be treated as a new and separate Transaction.**
